<section class="page-banner">
  <div style="max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;">
    <h1>Help & Support</h1>
    <p>Find answers to common questions about the data and the portal</p>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- FAQ ACCORDION -->
<section style="max-width:900px;margin:3rem auto;padding:0 2rem;">
  <h2 style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:2rem;">Frequently Asked Questions</h2>

  <style>
    .faq-item { margin-bottom:1rem; }
    .faq-title {
      background: var(--map-navy, #0f172a);
      color: white;
      padding: 1rem 1.5rem;
      border-radius: 8px;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-weight: 600;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    }
    .faq-title:hover {
      background: var(--map-navy-light, #1e293b);
      border-color: rgba(13,148,136,0.3);
    }
    .faq-content {
      display: none;
      background: var(--map-bg-section, #f1f5f9);
      padding: 1.5rem;
      border-left: 4px solid var(--map-red, #0d9488);
      border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
      line-height: 1.7;
      color: var(--map-text-muted, #64748b);
    }
    .faq-item.active .faq-content { display: block; }
    .faq-toggle {
      display: inline-block;
      transition: transform 0.2s ease;
      font-size: 1.2rem;
    }
    .faq-item.active .faq-toggle { transform: rotate(180deg); }
  </style>

  <div class="faq-item">
    <div class="faq-title" onclick="this.parentElement.classList.toggle('active')">
      <span>How do I access the CPP data?</span>
      <span class="faq-toggle">&#9660;</span>
    </div>
    <div class="faq-content">
      Go to the <a href="registry.html" style="color:var(--map-red);text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;">CPP Registry</a>. You can filter by region, district, business type and accreditation source, explore the interactive map, and download the full standardised dataset as CSV. All data is openly downloadable.
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="faq-item">
    <div class="faq-title" onclick="this.parentElement.classList.toggle('active')">
      <span>How do I find the nearest CPP to a location?</span>
      <span class="faq-toggle">&#9660;</span>
    </div>
    <div class="faq-content">
      The <a href="find-facility.html" style="color:var(--map-red);text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;">Find Pharmacy</a> tool will do this once the Demand-Side Access layer is wired up. In the meantime, use the Registry's region/district filters and search box to zero in on a specific area.
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="faq-item">
    <div class="faq-title" onclick="this.parentElement.classList.toggle('active')">
      <span>Can I download the data?</span>
      <span class="faq-toggle">&#9660;</span>
    </div>
    <div class="faq-content">
      The standardised registry is published as <strong>CSV</strong> &mdash; standard comma-separated values for spreadsheet and statistical analysis. Both the raw <code>.xls</code> inventory and the ETL script that produces the CSV are versioned in the repository.
    </div>
  </div>


  <div class="faq-item">
    <div class="faq-title" onclick="this.parentElement.classList.toggle('active')">
      <span>How frequently is the data updated?</span>
      <span class="faq-toggle">&#9660;</span>
    </div>
    <div class="faq-content">
      The current release is a snapshot of the Pharmacy Council of Tanzania CPP inventory. Refreshes will land whenever the Pharmacy Council or TFDA publish an updated accreditation list. Each release ships with a version tag and changelog.
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="faq-item">
    <div class="faq-title" onclick="this.parentElement.classList.toggle('active')">
      <span>What geography is currently covered?</span>
      <span class="faq-toggle">&#9660;</span>
    </div>
    <div class="faq-content">
      PharmaScope currently covers Tanzania Mainland (26 canonical regions). Zanzibar outlets are not yet included in the source inventory but the schema is ready to receive them. Cross-country expansion is not on the current roadmap.
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="faq-item">
    <div class="faq-title" onclick="this.parentElement.classList.toggle('active')">
      <span>How do I report data quality issues or errors?</span>
      <span class="faq-toggle">&#9660;</span>
    </div>
    <div class="faq-content">
      If you spot an incorrect outlet name, misplaced coordinate, or misspelled region, please email the team with the outlet UID (visible in the Registry table) and a short description. We track and fix these on every release.
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
